_about: The folk riddles of the evening and the trick questions of the children (#103; docs/RIDDLES.md, src/core/riddles.js). evening: the minutes of the day when Bà or the elder (tellers) says a new riddle to a hero who comes near (near: map cells), one new riddle each day at most, and none while a task or a raid is open. A riddle: its answer is a thing of the world that the child finds and taps (kinds: the kinds of the animals of the world, ids: entities such as Nghé, props: the props of the map objects); any thing of that kind counts, at most `find` half blocks from the tap. Its lines: riddle.<id> (the riddle), riddle.<id>.fit (how its words fit the thing), riddle.<id>.clue (which words point to the thing), riddle.<id>.answer. A trick question: trick.<id> and trick.<id>.answer; a child of the village asks it on a tap (at most one each day from each child, with the chance `chance`, and none in a folk game or a task), and says the answer after `wait` seconds. children: the people who ask. Each riddle and trick question has a source (sources): the published collection to check it against; page null and checked false: a person who knows Vietnamese folklore has not checked it yet (docs/QUESTIONS.md).
